text: Jen - dad's funeral Thurs @ 11, St Mary's. text her the night before, not the morning of

Haruto made redundant Fri. whole team gone, 40 odd people, told in one big Teams call at 4pm which is grim. v flat, says he's fine but clearly not. his partner Rebecca is due in March so the timing is awful. he's got 3 months garden leave and wants to use it to finish his forklift cert. maybe send him that LinkedIn post about the logistics firm hiring
Lukas & Dalia - their youngest starts reception Wed 3rd. ask how drop-off went that afternoon
pick up dry cleaning tmrw am before 10. then post office / return parcel
Yosef grad ceremony @ Leeds 14th at 2pm. his mum flying in day before. bring card
Sofia + Andre split. she's moved back to her sister's for now
Akira - son's GCSE results Thurs morning. he's more nervous than the kid lol

Chiara's nonna passed sun night. funeral prob next wk, Bari. she's flying out Tues, mum went ahead already. they were super close - nonna basically raised her til she was 8. she sounded ok on the phone but kept going quiet. check in a few days after she gets back, maybe take her for lunch. and ask Giulia if she knows the date of the funeral so I can send flowers to the church
bins out tonight - recycling wk
Shira - nursery settling-in sessions all this wk, 9-11. 2nd day was tears. Esther (her wife) doing pickups

Adebayo - redundancy consultation mtg Mon at 3pm w/ HR. they're cutting 6 of 9 in his dept. he's been there since 2015, mortgage just renewed, so properly scared. his union rep is coming along. also his daughter Asha's graduation is the Fri after, so he's trying to keep it together for that. must message him that eve to see how it went, then maybe lunch later in the wk
Asha's brother Omar graduating from Edinburgh in June. law. she's v proud, organising a surprise dinner the night after
Giulia - cat Biscotti put to sleep yday. 16 yrs old. gutted. drop round w/ flowers wkend
Irina - daughter Niamh's driving test 9:40 Fri. Irina mostly worried about the roundabout by the station
Thomas Fischer = Tom. leaving drinks cancelled, he's just going quietly. last day the 31st
dentist 8:15 Tues. then straight to work, no gym
Tadhg - grandad's anniversary mass Sun at 10. whole family going. he asked if I'd come, said yes

Mohammed - twins first day @ secondary Mon. one excited, other (Omar) dreading it - doesn't know anyone in his form, his best mate went to the other school. Mo's walking them in at 8 then going to work. Omar has asthma, worried about PE. ask Mo after school how Omar got on, and again at the end of the week
Arjun & Rosa - wedding's off. he's taking it hard, staying at his brother Hassan's

Rebecca - mum's memorial Sat afternoon, 2ish @ the cricket club. her mum played there for 30 yrs, captained the ladies' team. I'm doing sandwiches, Jen doing cakes. need to buy bread + fillings Fri eve, nothing with nuts - Rebecca's nephew has an allergy. get there by 1 to set up. her dad will want to do a speech but she thinks he'll struggle
Ava passed her MA!! viva went fine. grad in Dec
Naledi - dog Rolo missing since Tues morning. posters up round the park. share the post on fb

Graham laid off @ the plant after 22 yrs. no warning, letters handed out Monday morning. wants to retrain - electrician maybe, there's a course at the college starting Jan. wife Marisol back at work full time now so money ok-ish short term. their son Bruno home from uni at Xmas. Graham v proud, doesn't want pity. offer to lend him my books from the trade course
Bruno - son Andre's year 6 SATs wk of 12 May. tutor twice a wk
Niamh: breakup w/ Thomas last wk. didn't want to talk about it. just loves her pottery class atm - Weds eves
Haruto's dad - Nakamura-san - op Tues 7am. Haruto driving up the night before. ring him the day after
car MOT Fri at half 8. leave it there, bus to work. collect after 5
Jen O'Brien's daughter Alana - first ballet exam Sat morning. Jen said Alana's terrified. good luck msg Fri night
Lukas - divorce final last month. doing ok, new flat in Didsbury. hates cooking for 1
Omar - Dr Lee retiring end of term, Omar taking over his clinic list from Jan
Esther's mum's funeral the 9th at half 10, crem then wake @ the Royal Oak. don't forget card - sign from all of us
Dalia: redundancy confirmed. 3 months' pay. honestly relieved, hated the commute. starts job hunt after Xmas
Akira's daughter Shira graduates tmrw @ 11. dinner afterwards at the Thai place. he wants a photo of all of them
Yosef - grandma died, shiva at his parents' all wk. visit Weds eve? bring food, nothing w/ pork obv
returning the drill to B&Q + get filler & sandpaper. sat am
Sofia - 1st day at uni Mon 23rd. Bristol, history. nervous re halls. text her a week after to see how she's settling
Adebayo + his wife - eldest finishing primary, leavers' assembly Thurs 2pm. both taking afternoon off
Chiara mentioned she's into vinyl now, mostly 70s Italian stuff. Bday Nov - record token wd go down well

Andre - dad's diagnosis appt Mon morning, results the wk after. he's not sleeping, keeps googling symptoms. his brother Arjun lives in Glasgow so it's all on Andre for now. offered to drive them Mon, he said no but might change his mind. call him Sunday night, and text Mon afternoon once they're out
Asha: kids' school play cancelled (flooding in hall). her daughter Sofia devastated, had 3 lines
Giulia's son Arjun - 11+ exam Sat 9am. she's a wreck. text her Fri eve, then again that afternoon
Irina + Graham - finally graduated from the parenting course lol. also Irina's sister Chiara moving to Toronto in Feb
Rosa - lost her job @ the gallery. funding cut. applying for council roles. dog Pepper keeping her sane
me: book flights for Xmas by Fri. budget £300. check bag allowance

Thomas - mum in hospice since last Wed. family taking shifts. he's on nights Tues/Thurs, sister Esther does days. drained. eating crisps from the vending machine for dinner. send something - meal kit? ask Esther what she'd suggest. he loves those Gail's cinnamon buns
Mohammed & Shira - joint bday thing for the kids Sat at 3, soft play. I said I'd bring Ava's two
Tadhg's sister Niamh - graduation Fri week, nursing @ UCD. he's going over Thurs night, back Sun
Hassan v down. girlfriend left, took the dog. job also shaky - restructure announced. pint Thurs after work
Jen - Alana lost her first tooth lol. tooth fairy rate is apparently £2 now

Naledi's uncle's funeral in Durban 2nd Nov. she flies out the Tues before, back the Mon after. her mum's not well enough to travel so Naledi's speaking for the family. she's been writing the eulogy all week. need to ask how it went once she's home, and offer to pick her up from Heathrow - flight lands 6:40am
Graham - Uncle Tadhg passed 2 yrs ago, still finds Oct hard. likes being asked about him
Bruno + Marisol - baby's christening cancelled, rearranging for spring
Niamh: graduation photos up. masters in architecture. starting @ Foster's in Nov
Arjun - brother Hassan's redundancy hearing Weds 10am. Arjun prepping him. remind me to check in w/ Arjun Weds night
meal prep sun. grocery order arrives sat 7-8am

Rebecca's son Thomas - starting school Sept. she's already panicking about uniform, which school, the lot. applications due Jan 15th. she's looking at St Anne's and Oakfield, open days next month both on Saturdays. hand-me-downs from Ava's lot? text Ava tonight

Alana - grandad died Tues. funeral Tues 28th at 1pm, St Patrick's. she asked me to do a reading. she's holding up, sort of. her brother Lukas flying in from Perth the Sun before. practise reading at the weekend. also get a black tie - mine's gone missing - Sat morning
Alana's brother Lukas stays til the Fri after. Alana said dinner w/ both of them the night after the funeral, her place
Haruto - interview Thurs at 2 for warehouse supervisor. 1st one since the redundancy. nervous. msg him Weds pm good luck, and Fri to ask
nothing much. coffee w/ Giulia, talked mostly about the weather + her allotment. courgettes everywhere
